frequency_question: What proportion of major proposed rules establishing high-impact financial burdens reach formal final publication without being withdrawn or permanently enjoined before the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes rules designated as economically significant (>$100M impact or major policy shifts) that reached the NPRM stage and faced significant controversy; excludes minor administrative updates or rules abandoned before proposal.

cases.name: EPA Mercury and Air Toxics Reconsideration

coverage_note: 7 named major contested rulemakings; believed representative of politically sensitive high-stakes federal agency rule finalization rates.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list every minor agency adjustment, focusing instead on high-salience contested federal rules.
skeleton: 7 named major contested rules, 4 successful final publications meeting criteria without vacatur before deadline
validity_reason: Base rate tied to current administrative law framework and presidential term dynamics; expires at the end of the current political administration.
